description: Claim a creator's ad code (adcode_<uuid>) into the ad account. ONE-WAY: the code is single-use and cannot be unclaimed. Previews (format check only, nothing sent) unless confirm=true. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token.

ad_code.description: The creator's ad code, adcode_ followed by a uuid. It can be claimed only once.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

profile_id.description: Brand profile id; defaults to SNAP_BRAND_PROFILE_ID

name: snap_claim_ad_code
